content.title: Percutaneous edge-to-edge mitral valve repair recommendations (table excerpt)
content.notes: Recommendations apply to carefully selected patients who are not eligible for surgery and do not need coronary revascularization. OMT = optimal medical therapy; HF = heart failure.

recommendations.text: Percutaneous edge-to-edge mitral valve repair should be considered in carefully selected patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery and not needing coronary revascularization, who are symptomatic despite OMT and who fulfil criteria to achieve a reduction in HF hospitalizations.
recommendations.target_population: Patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery, not needing coronary revascularization, symptomatic despite OMT and who meet criteria for reducing HF hospitalizations

recommendations.text: Percutaneous edge-to-edge mitral valve repair may be considered to improve symptoms in carefully selected patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery and not needing coronary revascularization, who are highly symptomatic despite OMT and who do not fulfil criteria for reducing HF hospitalization.
recommendations.target_population: Patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery, not needing coronary revascularization, highly symptomatic despite OMT but not meeting criteria for reducing HF hospitalizations
